verdict.rationale: Teams docs show that bots can initiate and participate in conversations, that Outgoing Webhooks push channel messages to a web service, and that a Slack Bolt app can be ported to Teams. Together these imply real-time inbound message delivery to a developer's service. However, the pack never describes the bot messaging endpoint or event/activity subscription model directly, and a community comment notes that integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the bot messaging endpoint and activity types, evidence of non-message events (membership changes, reactions, installs) delivered in real time, any gateway/socket-style connection option, and independent hands-on corroboration.
